_note: wording: BA review — English drafted with AI
partialBanner: Partial results — the scan didn't fully complete (timeout or rate limit). Items found so far can still be downloaded.

queue.youtubeDisabled: YouTube download isn't available yet. Queueing is temporarily disabled.
queue.cookieInvalid: Invalid cookie. Update the cookie to use queueing.

section.hasMore: There are more items — click "Expand" to load more.
section.expandHint: Click this section to expand it and pick individual items.

expired.title: Session expired
expired.body: The previous discovery results have passed their TTL.

cookieUnavailable.title: Cookie not configured
cookieUnavailable.body: {{platform}} requires a login cookie but none is configured. Contact an admin to add one (Settings → Cookie).

cookieExpired.title: Cookie expired
cookieExpired.body: The {{platform}} cookie has expired. Please update it in Settings → Cookie → {{platform}}.

cookieBlocked.title: Cookie temporarily blocked
cookieBlocked.body: {{platform}} rate-limited us or detected a bot. The cookie unblocks automatically after 15 minutes (soft block) or 6 hours (hard block). Try again later.

cookiePartial.title: Partial content
cookiePartial.body: Public content is shown in full. Some posts require login and may be skipped when queueing.

singleDisabled.title: YouTube single video is temporarily unavailable
singleDisabled.body: YouTube downloads via the server are currently bot-blocked. Instead, paste a channel or playlist link to use Bulk Browse (requires a configured residential proxy).

proxyBad.title: YouTube proxy is not working
proxyBad.body: YTDL_PROXY is configured but can't connect. The system will retry automatically in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, contact an admin to check the proxy.

generic.cookieTitle: Sign-in required to use this feature
generic.proxyTitle: A proxy is required to use this feature
generic.cookieBody: {{platform}} requires a login session cookie. Contact an admin to add one.
generic.proxyBody: YouTube container discovery needs a residential proxy. Contact an admin to configure YTDL_PROXY.
